verdict.rationale: Sumsub offers Summy AI, which lets users create/configure verification levels and get applicant status summaries by describing requirements in plain language, and an MCP server that lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations under natural-language driven agent control. These are concrete natural-language interfaces, but they cover only specific features (level building, applicant overview) rather than full product operation, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability. missing for 10: broader coverage of all major workflows via NL commands, independent/hands-on verification of accuracy and reliability.
